### Observed differences

- Two activities that were not observed at all in the earlier window appear in the later one: A02 is present in about 57 in 100 traces (113 of 200) and A01 in about 15 in 100 (30 of 200). [OCC001, OCC002]
- In the later window A02 is always the final event of a trace (relative position 1.0 in all 113 occurrences), and A01 sits about two-thirds into the trace (median about 0.67); in the earlier window neither appeared at any position. [POS001, POS002]
- Activities that previously ended traces now lead into A02. In the earlier window A16 (about 20 in 100 traces) and A19 (about 29 in 100) always occurred as the last event and had no observed outgoing transitions; in the later window every observed outgoing transition of A16 and of A19 goes to A02, and both shifted from the final position to about 0.85. [DIR006, DIR008, POS007, POS008]
- A09 also feeds the new ending: earlier, its outgoing transitions split about evenly between A13 (48%) and A14 (52%); later, about half go to A02 (51%) and half to A13 (49%), with A14 no longer observed as a successor. [DIR004]
- A new approach route runs through A01: A10 now leads to A01 in about 42 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (A16, previously about 52 in 100, is no longer observed), A17 leads to A01 in half of its outgoing transitions (previously only A15, about 69%, and A16), and A01 always leads to A16; A01 precedes A16 and A02 in every trace where they co-occur. [DIR001, DIR005, DIR007, REL001, REL002]
- A02 co-occurs with A14 in about 39 in 100 traces, A03 in 35, A07 in 28, A19 in 22, A09 in 20 and A16 in 15, and it follows the partner in most shared traces (always for A16 and A19); in the earlier window A02 was never observed with any activity. [REL003, REL004, REL005, REL008, REL009, REL010]
- The former early block around A09 and A13 shrank and shifted: A09 now occurs in about 20 in 100 traces (previously 37) and repeats far less (mean 1.07 to 0.38 occurrences per trace; recurrence support 0.26 to 0.085); A13 falls from about 23 to 9 in 100 traces. Both now appear at later event positions (A09 median 0.22 to 0.63; A13 median 0.23 to 0.50), while A14 appears earlier (median 0.38 to 0.11). A07's outgoing transitions, previously split between A03 (about 52%) and A09 (about 48%), now go to A14 (about 51%) and A03, and A03 gained a direct transition to A09 (about 19%) while its transition to A08 fell from about 19% to 3%. [OCC003, OCC004, DIR002, DIR003, POS003, POS005, POS006]
- Pairs that previously often occurred together now rarely or never do: A09 and A14 co-occur in about 13 in 100 traces (previously 37), A13 and A14 in about 4 in 100 (previously 23), and A09 and A19 never co-occur (previously 22). Several ordered-pair distances were also redistributed (for example A03→A13 and A03→A14 gaps moving from 3 or 5 steps to 2 or 4), each based on small samples of roughly 6 to 38 observations. [REL011, REL012, REL013, LAG001, LAG002, LAG009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that a new concluding stage was added to the process: A02 appears as a new final activity, reached from A16 and A19 — which previously ended traces — and from about half of A09's outgoing transitions, while A01 is a new activity shortly before the end, fed by A10 and A17 and always leading to A16, so that routes such as A10 or A17 → A01 → A16 → A02 now run through the last third of about 15 in 100 traces, and A02 terminates about 57 in 100. [OCC001, OCC002, POS002, DIR001, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS007, POS008, REL001]

The screening context makes a sampling explanation unlikely: 42 items qualified against roughly 0.44 expected if nothing had changed (all in the control-flow family), far beyond what random re-splits of an unchanged process produce, and the hypothesis rests on direct, mutually consistent occurrence, positional, directional and relational evidence rather than on the number of items; A02's presence in 113 of 200 later traces also rules out a rare variant appearing in one window only. [OCC002, POS002, DIR006, DIR008]

Limitations: the evidence shows only immediate successions and event positions, so it cannot establish which conditions route a trace to the new ending, and it cannot rule out that the later window reflects a different case mix rather than a modified process; the roughly 43 in 100 later traces without A02 are not characterised. [OCC002, REL001]

Other differences: the middle-section restructuring — A09 and A13 occurring in fewer traces, repeating less and sitting at later event positions, A14 sitting earlier and now reached from A07, A03 gaining a direct edge to A09 while its edge to A08 nearly disappeared, and the former co-occurrences of A09 with A14 and A19 and of A13 with A14 largely vanishing — may be part of the same change or an independent difference; the evidence cannot separate the two. [OCC003, OCC004, DIR002, DIR003, POS003, POS005, POS006, REL011, REL012, REL013]

Let me analyse this evidence carefully.

Screening: 88 units tested, 42 items qualified, 0.44 expected by chance. So 42 items vs 0.44 expected — that's about 95 times the chance expectation. This is a count many times larger than expected, so the evidence as a whole cannot be explained by chance. All items are control-flow family (no time or resource items — no TWAIT, ASSIGN, CONC, HAND). So I should not discuss time or resources.

Now let me understand the behavioural picture.

OCC items:
- OCC001: A01 absent before (0 participation), present after in 15% of traces (30/200). Increased.
- OCC002: A02 absent before, present after in 56.5% of traces (113/200). Increased.
- OCC003: A09 decreased: participation 36.5% → 19.5%, mean occurrences 1.07 → 0.38, recurrence 0.26 → 0.085.
- OCC004: A13 decreased: participation 23% → 8.5%, mean 0.515 → 0.185.

DIR items:
- DIR001: A01's outgoing transitions: before empty (A01 never occurred), after 100% to A16. New activity with a fixed successor.
- DIR002: A03's outgoing shares redistributed: before A07 ~48%, A08 ~19%, A17 ~11%, A10 ~8%, A20 ~14%; after A07 ~53%, A09 ~19%, A20 ~13%, A17 ~4%, A10 ~7%, A08 ~3%. So A03 now sometimes leads to A09 (new edge, ~19%), A08 nearly gone.
- DIR003: A07's outgoing: before A03 ~51%, A09 ~49%; after A14 ~51%, A03 ~49%. So A07 no longer leads to A09; instead leads to A14 (new edge).
- DIR004: A09's outgoing: before A13 ~48%, A14 ~52%; after A02 ~51%, A13 ~49%. So A09 no longer leads to A14; instead leads to A02 (new edge).
- DIR005: A10's outgoing: before A15 ~48%, A16 ~52%; after A15 ~58%, A01 ~42%. A10 now leads to A01 instead of A16.
- DIR006: A16's outgoing: before empty, after 100% to A02. Wait — A16 occurred before (POS007 shows A16 support 0.2 before, 0.15 after; DIR007 shows A17→A16 before). But DIR006 says A16's outgoing profile before is empty. Hmm, support before 0 for DIR006. That's odd — A16 occurs in 20% of traces before but has no observed outgoing transitions? That could mean A16 is always the last activity in traces before (no outgoing). After, A16 leads to A02 in all 30 traces where it occurs. Interesting.
- DIR007: A17's outgoing: before A15 ~69%, A16 ~31%; after A01 50%, A15 50%. A17 now sometimes leads to A01.
- DIR008: A19's outgoing: before empty, after 100% to A02. A19 occurs before (POS008 support 0.29) but has no outgoing before; after it leads to A02.

POS items:
- POS001: A01 appears at mean position ~0.71 (relative position, presumably normalized 0-1) after; absent before.
- POS002: A02 appears at position 1.0 (the very end) in all its occurrences after; absent before. So A02 is a new final activity.
- POS003: A09 position moved later: mean 0.26 → 0.59, median 0.22 → 0.625.
- POS004: A10 position moved earlier: mean 0.72 → 0.46.
- POS005: A13 position moved later: mean 0.28 → 0.54.
- POS006: A14 position moved earlier: mean 0.39 → 0.20, median 0.375 → 0.105.
- POS007: A16 position: mean 1.0 → 0.854. So A16 was the last event before; now it's slightly before the end (because A02 comes after it).
- POS008: A19 position: mean 1.0 → 0.858. Same pattern.

REL items:
- REL001 (A01, A02): before neither 100%; after: co-occurrence 15%, B_only (A02 only) 41.5%, A_before_B 15%, neither 43.5%. So A02 appears in 56.5% of traces; when both appear, A01 before A02.
- REL002 (A01, A16): before B_only (A16 only) 20%; after co-occurrence 15% with A01 before A16.
- REL003 (A02, A03): before B_only (A03 only) 29.5%; after co-occurrence 35%, A_only (A02 only) 21.5%, B_before_A (A03 before A02) 20%, interleaved 15%. So A03 now precedes A02.
- REL004 (A02, A07): similar; A03... wait, A02 before? B_before_A means A07 before A02. After: co-occurrence 28%, A_only 28.5%, B_before_A 14.5%, interleaved 13.5%.
- REL005 (A02, A09): after co-occurrence 19.5%, A_only 37%, B_before_A 11%, interleaved 8.5%.
- REL006 (A02, A10): after co-occurrence 10.5%, A_only 46%, B_before_A 6.5%.
- REL007 (A02, A13): after co-occurrence 8.5%, A_only 48%, B_before_A 4%.
- REL008 (A02, A14): after co-occurrence 39%, A_only 17.5%, B_before_A 26.5%, interleaved 12.5%.
- REL009 (A02, A16): after co-occurrence 15%, A_only 41.5%, B_before_A 15%.
- REL010 (A02, A19): after co-occurrence 22%, A_only 34.5%, B_before_A 22%.
- REL011 (A09, A14): before co-occurrence 36.5% (A_before_B 10.5%, interleaved 26%); after co-occurrence only 12.5%, B_only (A14 only) 26.5%. So A09 and A14 now rarely occur together.
- REL012 (A09, A19): before co-occurrence 22%; after co-occurrence 0%, A_only 19.5%, B_only 22%. They became alternatives.
- REL013 (A13, A14): before co-occurrence 23%; after co-occurrence 4%, B_only (A14 only) 35%.

LAG items: distances between ordered pairs within five steps.
- LAG001 (A03→A13): before distances 3 (~46%) and 5 (~17%); after distances 2 (~40%) and 4 (~19%). Hmm, actually the components are labelled 1-5; these are gap sizes. Before gap 3 dominant; after gap 2 dominant.
- LAG002 (A03→A14): before gaps 3 and 5; after gaps 2 and 4.
- LAG003 (A07→A09): before gaps 1,3,4,5; after gaps 2,4.
- LAG004 (A07→A13): before gaps 2,4,5; after gaps 3,5.
- LAG005 (A07→A14): before gaps 2,4; after gaps 1,3.
- LAG006 (A07→A16): before gaps 3,4,5; after gap 4 only.
- LAG007 (A10→A16): before gaps 1,3,5; after gaps 2,4.
- LAG008 (A14→A09): before gaps 2,4,5; after gaps 1,3,5.

Before: A01 and A02 never occur. A09 occurs in 36.5% of traces, often repeated (mean 1.07 per trace, recurrence 0.26), early in the trace (mean position 0.26). A13 occurs in 23%, early (mean 0.28). A16 and A19 occur at the very end (position 1.0) — they are terminal activities. A14 occurs mid-trace (mean 0.39).

After: A01 appears in 15% of traces, always followed by A16 (DIR001), at position ~0.71. A02 appears in 56.5% of traces, always at position 1.0 (the last event) — a new final activity. A09's participation halved (36.5% → 19.5%), repetitions reduced (mean 1.07 → 0.38), and it moved later (0.26 → 0.59). A13's participation dropped (23% → 8.5%), moved later (0.28 → 0.54). So the picture: a new concluding segment was added. A02 is a new final activity that terminates 56.5% of traces. Paths into it: from A16, A19 (previously terminal activities), from A09, and via A01→A16→A02. A01 is a new activity that precedes A16. Meanwhile the old early block around A09/A13 (with repetitions) shrank and moved later; A14 moved earlier and A07 now flows into A14 rather than A09; A09 and A14, which used to co-occur, now rarely do (REL011), and A09 and A19 became alternatives (REL012), A13 and A14 too (REL013).

Hmm, wait. Let me reconsider. REL011: A09 and A14 co-occurrence dropped from 36.5% to 12.5%. REL013: A13 and A14 co-occurrence dropped from 23% to 4%. REL012: A09 and A19 co-occurrence dropped from 22% to 0%.

Actually, let me think again about whether the A09/A13 changes are a separate difference. The evidence shows:
- A09: participation 36.5% → 19.5%, mean occurrences 1.07 → 0.38 (repetitions largely stopped), position later.
- A13: participation 23% → 8.5%, position later.
- A07: previously split to A03/A09; now split to A14/A03. So the A07→A09 edge disappeared, replaced by A07→A14.
- A09: previously to A13/A14; now to A02/A13.

Here, several edges are new (A07→A14, A09→A02, A10→A01, A17→A01, A01, A02 new). So this is not a path-frequency shift; it's addition/removal of paths and activities — activities added (A01, A02), edges replaced.
